prerequisites: 1) Tier 2 user account exists: test+t2.access02@example.com with a valid password. 2) The account has completed KYC and displays Tier 2 in profile. 3) No feature flags blocking card or remittance features are active.
stepsToPerform: 1) Launch the app; verify Login screen appears. 2) Log in as test+t2.access02@example.com; verify dashboard loads. 3) Open Profile; verify verification status displays "Tier 2". 4) Navigate to Cards > Virtual; verify the action to apply for a virtual prepaid card is accessible; open the application screen; cancel to avoid creating state. 5) Navigate to Cards > Physical; verify an action to order a physical prepaid card is accessible; open the order screen; cancel to avoid creating state. 6) Navigate to Remittance > Send Money; verify the send flow entry screen is accessible (form to initiate a transfer is visible). 7) Navigate to Remittance > History; verify the history screen loads for the user. 8) Log out; verify return to the Login screen.

title: Access updates across features after Tier 2 verification
description: Validates the transition from Tier 1 to Tier 2 via KYC submission and verifies that previously restricted features (physical card, remittance send) become accessible. Automation: MEDIUM — requires document upload and status polling.
testDescription: A Tier 1 user submits KYC (ID + selfie), sees status change (Pending then Tier 2), and gains access to physical card ordering and the remittance send flow.
prerequisites: 1) Tier 1 user account exists: test+t1.access03@example.com with a valid password. 2) Synthetic KYC artifacts available: passport image (passport_access03.png) and selfie (selfie_access03.png). 3) Environment processes KYC to completion within test window so the user attains Tier 2.
stepsToPerform: 1) Launch the app; verify the Login screen is displayed. 2) Log in as test+t1.access03@example.com; verify dashboard loads. 3) Open Profile; verify current verification status displays "Tier 1". 4) Navigate to Cards > Physical; verify ordering a physical card is not accessible for Tier 1. 5) Navigate to Remittance > Send Money; verify the send flow entry is not accessible for Tier 1. 6) Navigate to KYC submission (Profile > Verification); select ID type "passport"; upload passport_access03.png and selfie_access03.png; submit; verify submission completes. 7) Return to Profile; verify the status reflects "Pending" after submission. 8) Refresh/check again until the status shows "Tier 2" (within the test window); verify the Tier 2 status is visible. 9) Navigate to Cards > Physical; verify the order action is now accessible. 10) Navigate to Remittance > Send Money; verify the send flow entry screen is now accessible. 11) Log out; verify return to the Login screen.
expectedResult: 1) User status transitions from Tier 1 to Pending after submission, then to Tier 2. 2) Physical card ordering becomes accessible only after Tier 2. 3) Remittance send flow becomes accessible only after Tier 2.
uiScreen: Login, Dashboard, Profile, KYC Submission, Cards (Physical), Remittance (Send)
testData: User: test+t1.access03@example.com / ******; KYC images: passport_access03.png, selfie_access03.png (synthetic).
assumptions: KYC review completes and promotes the user to Tier 2 during the test run.

title: Tier 1 sees virtual card option but not remittance send
description: Ensures Tier 1 users can see/apply for a virtual card per policy but cannot access remittance send. Protects feature gating by verification tier. Automation: MEDIUM — UI presence/absence checks.
testDescription: A Tier 1 user confirms visibility of the virtual prepaid card application option and confirms the absence of any UI control to start an international remittance.
prerequisites: 1) Tier 1 user account exists: test+t1.access04@example.com with a valid password. 2) No prior remittance activity for this account (not required but simplifies UI observations).
stepsToPerform: 1) Launch the app; verify the Login screen is displayed. 2) Log in as test+t1.access04@example.com; verify dashboard loads. 3) Open Profile; verify current verification status displays "Tier 1". 4) Navigate to Cards > Virtual; verify an action to "apply for a new virtual prepaid card" is visible. 5) Click the virtual card apply action to confirm the application screen is accessible; cancel to avoid creating state. 6) Navigate to Remittance; verify there is no visible control to initiate a "Send Money" transfer for Tier 1. 7) Attempt to locate any alternate entry point for remittance send within the Remittance area; verify none is accessible. 8) Log out; verify return to the Login screen.
expectedResult: 1) The virtual prepaid card application entry point is visible to Tier 1. 2) No control to initiate an international remittance (send money) is accessible to Tier 1.
testData: User: test+t1.access04@example.com / ******.
assumptions: UI reflects access rules by hiding/disabling restricted features for Tier 1.
